children.innerHTML: Getting here is half the cure.
Three hours from Copenhagen, then a bus, then sand. The phone signal thins out exactly when it should.

Three and a half hours from Copenhagen, all of it worth the window seat.
Tell the driver Tide House. They know. Twenty-five minutes.
On sand, into the wind. Leave the wheelie bag's dignity at the stop.
